sql: with f as (  select fl.market_ticker t, split_part(fl.market_ticker,'-',1) ser, split_part(fl.market_ticker,'-',2) game, lo.strategy book,   lower(fl.side) side, fl.price::numeric px, coalesce(fl.quantity,0)::numeric q, coalesce(fl.fee,0)::numeric fee, fl.filled_at  from fills fl join live_orders lo on lo.kalshi_order_id=fl.kalshi_order_id  where lo.strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and split_part(fl.market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXNFLTOTAL','KXITFMATCH','KXITFWMATCH','KXATPCHALLENGERMATCH')), r as (  select market_ticker t, max(case when resolved_value=100 then lower(side) when resolved_value=0 then case when lower(side)='yes' then 'no' else 'yes' end end) res  from paper_trades where status='settled' and resolved_value in (0,100)   and split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXNFLTOTAL','KXITFMATCH','KXITFWMATCH','KXATPCHALLENGERMATCH') group by 1), m as (  select f.ser, f.game, f.t, f.book, f.side, r.res, sum(q) q, sum(px*q)/sum(q) px, sum(fee) fee, min(filled_at) f0,   (case when r.res is null then null when r.res=f.side then 100*sum(q) else 0 end - sum(px*q))/100.0 - sum(fee) pnl  from f left join r on r.t=f.t group by 1,2,3,4,5,6), x as (  select *, case when 100-px<=7 then 'b6-7' when 100-px<=10 then 'c8-10' when 100-px<=20 then 'd11-20' else 'e>20' end band,   to_char(f0,'YYYY-MM') mon from m where res is not null), cells as (  select 'book' dim, ser, book cell, game, t, q, px, pnl, (res<>side) lost from x  union all select 'band', ser, band, game, t, q, px, pnl, (res<>side) from x  union all select 'month', ser, mon, game, t, q, px, pnl, (res<>side) from x  union all select 'all', ser, 'all', game, t, q, px, pnl, (res<>side) from x), g as (select dim, ser, cell, game, sum(pnl) gp from cells group by 1,2,3,4), gs as (select dim, ser, cell, count(*) games, round(avg(gp)::numeric,4) mean_g, round((stddev_samp(gp)/sqrt(count(*)))::numeric,4) se_g, count(*) filter (where gp<0) games_lost from g group by 1,2,3) select c.dim, c.ser, c.cell, count(*) mkt_book_rows, sum(c.q) contracts, round(sum(c.px*c.q)/sum(c.q),2) avg_px,  round(100*sum(case when c.lost then c.q else 0 end)/sum(c.q),2) loss_pct_ct, round(sum(c.pnl),2) net, round(100*sum(c.pnl)/sum(c.q),2) c_per_ct,  gs.games, gs.mean_g, gs.se_g, gs.games_lost from cells c join gs using (dim, ser, cell) group by c.dim, c.ser, c.cell, gs.games, gs.mean_g, gs.se_g, gs.games_lost order by 2,1,3
